sources.level_band: 5 to 8 (M6 item 0, slice belt): the creature levels of the cells' one generator, wcid 2007 'Newbie Aluvian Generator' (the pinned world SQL v0.9.296, the weenie_properties_generator rows of object 2007 and PropertyInt 25 'Level' of each child), are all 8, the 5% row included: that row is the Gnawer Shreth 19263, level 8, not the level 2 Gnawer Shrethlet 26686 this table first named (M6 item 7: unlisted, the Shreth was never shot and held its spot's one creature for good, the climb's slowdown from level 12); the Shreth brings its own young, the Shrethlet (level 2, 35 XP, generator row of 19263), which holds no spot and stays below the floor; the floor 4 is the Black Rabbit and the Chicken of generator 5150, shot when they stand in reach (outdoor.creatures, spawn_mass 0); the ceiling 8 is the highest level any child of the generator has. AutopilotScenario.TargetBand lowers the top to the character's level + 5, so a level 5 mage hunts 4-8. Not the belt's 8-20, whose generators 1999 and 2001 also roll levels 15 to 30

sources.vendors: the pinned world SQL v0.9.296, read offline (the landblock_instance rows of landblock 0xA9B4 whose weenie is a Vendor, the weenie_properties_create_list rows of destination 4, PropertyInt 19 'Value' and PropertyFloat 38 'SellPrice'); price = max(1, ceil(1.35 x Value - 0.1)) as ACE's GetSellCost (Vendor.cs 577-585 @95ef426d). The three rows are the Black Spawn Den profile's rows verbatim in guid, cell, point, stop_cell, stop_point and buys_item_types (that profile's sources text gives the stops: Archmage Cindrue's stop is the entry hall 0xA9B40117, Renald's the clear floor of his front room, Thelnoth's his own cell), with a new 'sells' list. Archmage Cindrue (wcid 2304) sells every ware of the climber's lines: the scarabs Lead 691 (14) and Iron 689 (68), the Prismatic Taper 20631 (30), the herbs (14), the powders and potions (7), the talismans (7) and the twelve coloured tapers (34); her CreateList holds all of them in the pinned SQL, so no line is carried. Thelnoth Cort the Healer (wcid 715) sells the Mana Potion 379 (230). Shopkeeper Renald the Elder (wcid 718) lists no supply line and stays as the buyer of the weapons and armour the creatures drop (buys_item_types 0x480467A7, buy_price 0.9); his sells list is empty because this profile's kit is empty. Not listed: the Scrivener of Item Magic (the den's learn-list vendor), which serve a level-80 kit; TODO(m6-outskirts-profile): the later rung passes decide whether the outskirts need them M6 2 b (the gear floor, GearFloor; the pinned world SQL v0.9.296 read offline from its zip, weenie_properties_create_list destination 4 and PropertyInt 19 'Value', the price rule above): Archmage Cindrue also sells the Wand 2472 (create list row 21071; Value 200, 270 pyreals: the floor's caster, the cheapest caster a Holtburg vendor of this profile sells; her Wand 5539, row 21070, Value 100, burden 125, is the den profile's rejected heavier one and is not listed), the four Mana Charges she sells full (rows 21051-21054: Tiny 4612 Value 350 = 473, Small 4613 Value 650 = 878, Moderate 4614 Value 1,500 = 2,025, High 4615 Value 2,500 = 3,375; the caster's mana want, CasterManaRule; her Minor and Lesser Mana Stones are sold empty and are not listed) and her ten trade notes (rows 21060-21069: 2621-2627 and 20628-20630, priced as ACE sells a promissory note, max(1, ceil(1.15 x the face - 0.1)), Vendor.cs 577-585 @95ef426d, as the den profile's 287,500 for the 250,000; the purse lists no note, so no trip buys one: the notes' behaviour is item 2 slice d's). Ecutha the Tailor (wcid 719) is the den profile's row verbatim (guid 0x7A9B4025, cell 0xA9B4012A at (56.52, 132, 66.12) from her landblock_instance row; int property 74 = 262148 = 0x40004; float 37 0.9, float 38 1.35; TODO(m6-ecutha-stop-point) as there) and sells the Faran Robe with Hood 5851 (her create list row 12693; Value 50, 68 pyreals; ValidLocations 0x7F01, ClothingPriority 0x17F00): the floor's robe, bought only when no chest-covering piece is worn (the Pathwarden robe is worn from the chest on). The 'loot' section is M6 7 AR's, its source has the figures; Monyra the Jeweler 716 is the den profile's row verbatim (guid 0x7A9B4020, cell 0xA9B40117, mask 0x40808 Jewelry, Gem and the notes): the only Holtburg buyer of a ring or a bracelet: gate A's trips kept 7 bracelets 'outside' every listed mask Shopkeeper Renald the Elder 718 also sells the Leather Gauntlets 56 (Value 1,100, 1,485 pyreals; armour level 130, burden 270, ValidLocations 0x20, ClothingPriority 0x8000, no wield requirement; his create list holds it in the pinned SQL): the gear floor's hand armour (M6 7 AH: a corpse run's replace step buys it when no worn piece covers the hands). M6 8 D (m5-side-packs-use, m5-pack-short): the Pack row of Shopkeeper Renald the Elder: SELECT weenie_Class_Id FROM weenie_properties_create_list WHERE object_Id = 718 AND destination_Type = 4 AND weenie_Class_Id = 136 (one row, the world SQL v0.9.296); weenie 136 is a Container (ItemType 0x200, ItemsCapacity 24, PropertyInt 19 'Value' 65); price = max(1, ceil(1.35 x 65 - 0.1)) = 88. M6 14 grocer (the owner, 2026-11-13: sell the empty flasks; live 2026-11-13 04:54 UTC: the supply trip named every Empty Flask outside Monyra the Jeweler's mask and kept it, and none of the four other Holtburg buyers here takes its type): Fispur Ansel the Grocer 714 (holtburggrocer) is the sixth Holtburg row (guid 0x7A9B4024, cell and stop_cell 0xA9B4016A, his shop, point (78.9714, 38.5313, 94.005), buys_item_types 0x00446220 = Food 0x20 + Container 0x200 + Writable 0x2000 + Key 0x4000 + PromissoryNote 0x40000 + CraftCookingBase 0x400000, buy_price 0.9, no 'sells': a loot buyer only): SELECT li.guid, HEX(li.obj_Cell_Id), li.origin_X, li.origin_Y, li.origin_Z, i.value, f.value FROM landblock_instance li JOIN weenie_properties_int i ON i.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND i.type = 74 JOIN weenie_properties_float f ON f.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND f.type = 37 WHERE li.weenie_Class_Id = 714 (one row: 2056994852, A9B4016A, 78.9714, 38.5313, 94.005, 4481568, 0.9; a SELECT on the world copy, 2026-11-13). The Empty Flask (wcid 7940 flasksimple, ItemType 0x400000 CraftCookingBase, Value 1, MaxStackSize 1, so each one takes a slot; one is left by each potion she drinks, about 13 an hour) is in no other listed vendor's mask; ACE pays max(1, floor(0.9 x 1 + 0.1)) = 1 pyreal a flask (Vendor.cs GetBuyCost 591-599 @95ef426d). His MerchandiseMinValue (int 75) is 0 and his MerchandiseMaxValue (int 76) 1,000,000, and ACE's sale reads neither (Player_Commerce.cs VerifySellItems 232-298 @95ef426d: the mask, IsSellable, Retained, a Value of 1 or more, an empty container). Every other type of his mask is also Shopkeeper Renald the Elder's (0x480467A7), so he is listed after Renald: a tie of the loot buyers' counts goes to the profile's earlier row (ResupplyPlanner.LootBuyers), and that stays Renald. Her drinks (the Mana Potion 379, the Potion of Healing 377, the Health and Mana Tinctures 27319 and 27322) are Misc 0x80, outside his mask, and the sale keeps every drink she uses whatever a mask takes (ResupplyRun.DrinkInUse, m6-sale-keeps-drinks); a pack (Container) and a trade note are never offered (ResupplyRun.SaleItems). His stop is his own cell as Thelnoth's, Ecutha's and Monyra's are (the station's request stops ShopLeg.UnseenVendorReachMetres short of his point): the dat tests walk every vendor of the den's profile from Holtburg's lifestone, his leg among them (ResupplyRouteDatTests: the room graph's path, about 32 m, enters his shop through the room 0xA9B4016E and ends in 0xA9B4016A; VendorStopConfirmDatTests: the walker's pre-check confirms it and his point stands on the floor through the statics, and The_stations_walk_from_the_lifestone_to_the_Grocer_enters_his_shop_and_passes_the_pre_check plans the station's own request, his point with that range); the shop's two doors (0x7A9B401E and 0x7A9B401F, world objects the dats do not hold) and his body are not in those tests, and the walk to him has not been run live (TODO(m6-grocer-stop-point)).
sources.spell_plan: M6 item 0 slice belt, from the ladder rung 'outskirts' (ladder/war-mage.json: spell_level 1-2, element fire): one row, character levels 1 to 9, Flame Bolt at spell level 2 as the cap. The mage's book holds Flame Bolt I from creation (starterGear.json War Magic spells, ACE PlayerFactory.cs @95ef426d: Flame Bolt I is not specialisation-only) and the choice picks the highest level the book holds under the cap (FightScenario.ChooseLevel); Flame Bolt II is cast at 74% at a War Magic skill of about 65 (SkillCheck.GetMagicSkillChance), so the cap is a plan value until item 1's fizzle rule (D4) M6 7 AR (the audit's row 2): the rows reach level 21, where the gates can hold her here: 1-15 cap at II, 16-21 at III: Flame Bolt III is cast from War Magic 143 on the live skill, so its components are the profile's and the stop and trip lines guard them
sources.components: the full formula of the account 'test' (Winnie's account), not the foci formula: the formula depends on the account name (SpellTable.GetSpellFormula, ACE.DatLoader RandomizeVersion1, from the hash of the account name; SpellFormulaRules.CustomizeForAccount), read from the dats by HuntingGroundDatTests.The_outskirts_components_are_the_full_formula_of_the_account_test. Flame Bolt I (spell 27): Lead Scarab, Hawthorn, Powdered Onyx, Turpeth, Birch Talisman; Flame Bolt II (spell 81): Iron Scarab, Grey Taper, Hawthorn, Powdered Onyx, Turpeth, Birch Talisman. If the mage keeps the Foci of Strife that ACE's creation grants a War Magic character (starterGear.json, PlayerFactory.cs @95ef426d; HasFoci, Player_Spells.cs 458-488), ACE casts the foci formula instead (Lead Scarab and 1 Prismatic Taper for Flame Bolt I; Iron Scarab and 2 Prismatic Tapers for II); the supply lines hold both, so either formula casts. A different account gives different coloured tapers, herbs and powders: TODO(m6-outskirts-account-formula) M6 7 AR: Flame Bolt III (spell 82): the Lodge's rows verbatim: 1 Copper Scarab and 3 Prismatic Taper on the foci formula, Copper Scarab, Red Taper, Hawthorn, Indigo Taper, Powdered Onyx, Turpeth, Birch Talisman on the account's
sources.supplies: M6 14 (m6-life-through): Harm Other I to IV add Mandrake 775 and Hemlock Talisman 747 on the account test's formula (AccountFormula.Counts, the dats), Values 10 and 5 (weenie_properties_int type 19), sold by Archmage Cindrue 2304 (weenie_properties_create_list rows 20989 and 21023, destination 4) at ceil(1.35 x Value - 0.1) = 14 and 7, one each, no trip line and no stop line, as M6 7 AN's: a missing one drops the level by name (LevelFloor); read on the read-only world copy 2026-11-12. M6 7 AN: the regeneration lines, the drains and Heal Self add Alder Talisman 627 and Damiana 768 on the account test's formula, sold by Archmage Cindrue 2304 at ceil(1.35 x Value - 0.1), one each, no stop line (RechargeComponentTests pins every component of these lines). M6 7 AK: the self buffs and the item armor lines I to IV on the account test's formula (AccountFormula.Counts, the dats): every component of them one each, all sold by Archmage Cindrue 2304, price ceil(1.35 x Value - 0.1), no stop line and no trip line: a missing one drops the level by name (LevelFloor). M6 7 AD: the dance's lines (Stamina to Mana Self I on the account test's formula: Lead Scarab, Saffron, Powdered Amber, Quicksilver, Willow Talisman; ComponentLoss 0.01 x CDM 1 for a herb or powder, 0.1 for a scarab or talisman): trip_under 0 and stop_under 0 as M6 7 X's lines: they call no trip and stop no run, a press short of one leaves the rest to the regeneration, named. 140 presses an hour burn 1.4 of each herb and powder, so keep 4 is nearly three hours between trips (2 here: a press on the outskirts is rare, no rest rule, and the purse and the burden are the rung's). sized from the burn (Spell.TryBurnComponents, Spell.cs 157-189 @95ef426d): a slot burns with the chance ComponentLoss x CDM x min(1, Power / skill) per cast, the skill factor taken as 1 (the worst case). Flame Bolt I has ComponentLoss 0 (never burns), Flame Bolt II 0.05; herbs, powders, potions, coloured tapers and the Prismatic Taper have CDM 1, scarabs and talismans 0.1 (the SpellComponentTable). The rung: 90 kills an hour (the ladder's modelled rate; the move-on floor is 45) at the ceiling of 4.9 casts a kill (ladder/war-mage.json) is 441 casts an hour, all of them Flame Bolt II as the worst case = 22 of each of Grey Taper, Hawthorn, Powdered Onyx and Turpeth an hour (0.05 a cast), 2.2 of the Iron Scarab and the Birch Talisman, and on the foci formula 44 Prismatic Tapers (2 slots). Keep 40 of the four heavy lines (1.8 hours of the worst burn), trip_under 10 (27 minutes left against a trip of a few minutes), stop_under 2 (a cast needs 1, one more, as the den's lines); Iron Scarab and Birch Talisman keep 10, trip_under 3; Prismatic Taper keep 60 (1.4 hours), trip_under 15 (20 minutes), stop_under 3 (a Flame Bolt II cast needs 2); Lead Scarab keep 20 (no spell here burns more than 0.001 of it a cast), trip_under 5. Armor Self I (Lead Scarab, Wormwood, Powdered Onyx, Cobalt, Cedar Talisman; ComponentLoss 0, never burns) and Heal Self I (Lead Scarab, Hyssop, Powdered Amber, Colcothar, Willow Talisman; ComponentLoss 0.01) are the level I self spells of a War Magic specialist who trains Life Magic (starterGear.json): their lines keep 6, trip_under 3, stop_under 2. Mana Potion 379 (Thelnoth, 230): a reserve, as the den's line: keep 5, trip_under 2, stop_under 0 (no potion is a shortage, not a stop). Every ware is bought at Holtburg, so no line is carried. One full restock at these keeps is 6,838 pyreals at the vendors' prices; the climber starts with 10,000 pyreals (starterGear.json, the Jump skill's gear: Pyreal x10000, ACE PlayerFactory.cs @95ef426d) plus 10 Lead Scarabs and 50 Prismatic Tapers (5 and 25 for each of War Magic and Life Magic), so the first trip buys about 5,200 and the purse covers it. kit: none; the Pathwarden chest gives the mage its robe, gauntlets and boots (quests/pathwarden.json) and the creation gives a Training Wand, so no vendor item is worn or wielded from this profile. purse: coin 10,000, no notes (nothing is granted in a cheat-free climb, M6 D7: the figure is the starting stack). burden_trip_percent 90 is the section default. M6 0 F8 (the first climb probe: Winnie at 129% of her capacity after one restock; supersedes the keeps above, which were sized for a high Strength): her capacity at Strength 10 is 150 x 10 = 1,500 (EncumbranceSystem.EncumbranceCapacity), the line 90% = 1,350. The probe read 1,935 after the trip bought 247 components (1,063 by the SQL burdens: 4 each, the Prismatic Taper 6, the Mana Potion 15), so the pack was 872 before. The foci formula is what she casts while she holds the foci (HasFoci, Player_Spells.cs 458-488 @95ef426d: a Lead or Iron Scarab and one or two Prismatic Tapers a cast, Flame Bolt I burns nothing), so the full-formula lines are the backup if the foci are lost (the audit stops a run without them, F2) and are kept at 2 each (the 12 herb, powder, talisman and scarab lines other than Lead, 2 x 4 = 8 BU a line, 104 BU with the Iron Scarab), the Mana Potion at 1 (15 BU), the Lead Scarab at the 10 and the Prismatic Taper at the 50 the creation gives (trip_under 4 and 15, stop_under 2 and 3 as before). One restock from nothing adds 104 + 15 = 119 BU: 872 + 119 + the trinket 60 + the robe 200 = 1,251 = 83% of the capacity, under the 90% line with 99 BU to spare (quests/pathwarden.json carries the same arithmetic for its pick-ups, reserve 120). The restock at these keeps is far under the 10,000 purse. TODO(m6-outskirts-profile): the pyreals from sold loot and the learn scrolls are item 3's pass. M6 0 lead (live probe 3): a fresh climber holds 2,460 BU before the chest (the Academy Coat 600, the starter Leather Boots 420, the two foci 400 each, the Prismatic Tapers 300, the read-only SELECT of her possessions); the Pathwarden station drops the clothing its pieces replace (the coat and the boots) and takes the robe 200 and the trinket 60, so she runs at about 1,700 BU, 113% of 1,500, slowed by ACE's burden mod (EncumbranceSystem.GetBurdenMod: 2 - 1.13 = 0.87 of the run rate). burden_trip_percent 150: the climber's runs loot nothing, so a trip cannot shed burden and a 90% line would trip every cycle; 150% (half speed) is the line where a trip is called and the run stops by name if it cannot help. Strength ranks are item 1's credit plan (TODO(m6-climber-strength)) M6 2 d (the savings as trade notes; Cindrue sells every note, rows 21060-21069): the purse's coin is the FLOOR the coin is kept at, 2,700 pyreals, the most one trip can spend: a restock from nothing at the keeps above is 2,270 (10 Lead Scarabs at 14, 2 Iron Scarabs at 68, 2 Grey Tapers at 34, 2 of each of the eleven other herb, powder and talisman lines at 7 to 14, 50 Prismatic Tapers at 30, 1 Mana Potion at 230; summed from the stock rows and the vendors' prices above), plus the floor's Wand at 270 and Faran Robe with Hood at 68 (GearFloor) = 2,608, rounded up to 2,700 (a Mana Charge, 473 to 3,375, is paid by selling a note when the coin is short: SellNote). Coin above it is surplus. From level 6 a death takes half the coin and none of the trade notes (the ladder note section 11.1 'Death': Player_Death.cs:347-360, 629-663 @95ef426d; a note is bonded and is not coin), so the surplus is kept as notes: the trips buy the notes of min_note 10,000 and up (the 10,000 to the 250,000, at 1.15 times the face, Vendor.cs 577-585), the largest first. min_note is chosen by two numbers: (1) a note costs 15% of its face (13% of the coin spent), the death takes 50% of the coin it finds, so a note pays for itself once the chance of a death before the money is spent passes 26%; the surplus is never spent in levels 1 to 9, so any surplus that outlives a few hours is worth converting; (2) the coin left exposed is under the floor plus the smallest note's price (2,700 + 11,500 = 14,200), so a death takes at most 7,100, and the creation stack of 10,000 is under that line (7,300 above the floor is under the 11,500 of the smallest note), so it stays coin: no premium is paid on it during levels 1 to 5, where a death takes nothing. The default 25,000 would leave up to 30,000 exposed, far more than this climber ever holds. The one note listed is the note the trips buy toward (ResupplyRun.NoteToBuy reads the largest purse note a profile vendor sells; the trips offer every note of min_note and up); count 1 is the loader's minimum, nothing grants it (the climber is never built: M6 D7, no purse grant is made for this ground), TODO(m6-purse-note-count): a count of 0 for a ground that grants no note. M6 7 V (the r1h climb: at level 10 with 14 coin the counters called the Mana Potion trip over and over, and one trip spent 9,907 on 198 items): trip_spend_percent 60: one trip's stock buys spend at most 60 percent of the purse (coin and note faces), so the coin for the next trip stays (ResupplyPlanner.BuyList buys the lines under their trip lines first, the components before the potion, then tops up to the keeps in the same order); a trip line whose price the purse cannot pay is held back (LogisticsCounters, logged once a line), so the fight goes on. The outskirts' lines are already at rung scale (a full restock 2,270 against 10,000), so only the budget is added. M6 7 X (spells are the armor): the stock lines of Armor Self I and II and Mana Renewal Self I and II on the account test's formula (AccountFormula.Counts: no focus of Life Magic is held; SpellFormulaRules.CustomizeForAccount over the dats, pinned by HuntingGroundDatTests.A_climbers_low_grounds_carry_the_protective_lines_formula): keep 1 here, so the purse floor of 2,700 still pays one full restock with the Wand and the robe, 2,697 (2 on the rung grounds: two casts: the formula burns a component only at ComponentLoss 0.05 x CDM 0.1 a cast, Spell.TryBurnComponents, Spell.cs 157-189 @95ef426d, and a buff is cast twice an hour)), trip_under 0 (a trip that happens buys them and none is called for them: r2b's trip the moment she arrived, as the Mana Potion line), stop_under 0 (a buff short of a component steps down a level, BuffCycle.Choose; it never ends the run). Each is a row of Archmage Cindrue's create list (weenie 2304, destination 4: Violet 21042, Green 21038, Brown 21043, Blue 21040, Turquoise 21039, Orange 21036, White 21044, Wormwood 20994, Mugwort 20990, Cobalt 21011, Vitriol 21019, Gypsum 21013, Powdered Amber 20997, Cedar Talisman 21031, Willow Talisman 21030; Value 25 a taper, 10 a herb, 5 the rest; price = max(1, ceil(1.35 x Value - 0.1)): 34, 14, 7). M6 7 AR: purse coin 4,500: the floor the coin is kept at follows the restock from nothing at these keeps, 4,536 (the two scarab lines and Flame Bolt III's Red and Indigo Taper, keep 2, trip_under 1, stop_under 1), the rule of M6 2 d above. M6 7 AR (the audit's rows 12, 19): Mana Potion trip_under 0: 6 trips an hour in climb3 for one potion at 230: the rest and the press are her mana; Copper Scarab keep 3, trip_under 1, stop_under 1 (Flame Bolt III and the III lines burn it, the plan's check GearKit.CastBurns reads the stop line) and Silver Scarab keep 3, trip_under 1, stop_under 0: one scarab pays one line, a fizzle may burn it and nothing called a trip, so a III or IV line lapsed; 3 + 3 cost 1,419 and a line short of one is named by the pass (LevelFloor) and calls the trip at none M6 8 I (round 1 of 2026-11-09, level 11: 89,190 coin carried and the purse said no notes, because min_note 250,000 meant a 287,500 buy; the death then took half): purse coin 30,000 and min_note 10,000, as the Burrow and the Lodge read: ACE takes half of loose coin at level 6 and over and no trade note (@95ef426d WorldObjects/Player_Death.cs:675-685) and from level 11 at most one item at a time (:526-536, :629-650), so a note is close to safe and the coin above 30,000 is converted from the 10,000 note up (11,500 at the vendor). Overrides the 4,500 and the 250,000 above. M6 14 T (the sprint of 2026-11-12, levels 6 to 9: after a visit with 6,082 coin left, nine of these lines sat at 2 with a trip line and a stop line of 2, each one burn from sending her home at once): the twelve full-formula lines (Grey Taper, Hawthorn, Powdered Onyx, Turpeth, Birch Talisman, Wormwood, Cobalt, Cedar Talisman, Hyssop, Powdered Amber, Colcothar, Willow Talisman) keep 4, trip_under 2 and stop_under 2 as before: a visit leaves each two burns clear of its line (LogisticsCounters.ClearOf reads 3). Her own Item Enchantment casts burn four of them on the account's formula (Hyssop, Powdered Onyx, Cobalt, Turpeth), so the lines are not only the lost-foci backup. Two more of each cost 264 pyreals (Grey Taper 34, the three herbs 14, the eight powders and talismans 7, each times two) and 96 burden (4 a component); the first restock's burden is 1,106, and 872 + 1,106 + 260 = 2,238 stays under the 150% line of a Strength 10 capacity (2,250).
sources.hold_spots: none: the hunt stands at its cells and holds no spot
sources.respawn: none listed: the creatures are ACE encounters, not placed generator instances with fixed guids (the pinned world SQL v0.9.296, encounter table: generator wcid 2007 'Newbie Aluvian Generator' at each of the ten cells; each child's delay is 300 s and init_Create = max_Create = 1, so a cell holds one creature and makes the next 300 s after the first dies); ACE creates the generator at the spot when the landblock loads
sources.tour: none: the hunt visits outdoor.cells in their order
sources.outdoor: cells: the ten nearest cells to Holtburg (42.5N 33.6E) of the pinned world SQL v0.9.296 encounter table (weenie_Class_Id 2007) whose terrain reads dry, nearest first; the cell id is landblock << 16 | (cell_X * 8 + cell_Y + 1) and the map coordinates are ((landblock y * 192 + cell_Y * 24 + 12) / 240 - 102 N, (landblock x * 192 + cell_X * 24 + 12) / 240 - 102 E), the rule the belt's cells use; the stop point is the cell's centre (cell_X * 24 + 12, cell_Y * 24 + 12), z 0 because the terrain height is read from the dats at the point. The generator 2007 has 355 encounter cells within 5 map units of Holtburg; of the twenty nearest, eight read as water (the lake north of the town: in 0xA9B5, 0xA8B5, 0xA9B6, 0xAAB5, 0xA7B4, 0xA7B5 and 0xABB4) and are left out, as are the cells of the harmless generator 5150 (Black Rabbit and Chicken, level 4, each half of a roll; five cells in this ring, none toured, one creature each): the hunt takes those two when they stand in reach, with spawn_mass 0 because no listed cell rolls them. The cell terrain is the dat test's reading (HuntingGroundDatTests: water by the cell's four corner vertices, steep by the surface normal against the physics floor). creatures: the children of generator 2007 (names, PropertyInt 25 'Level'); spawn_mass is the chance that one roll of the generator spawns the creature (cumulative probability rows, ACE WorldObject_Generators.cs 120-213 @95ef426d: each row's share is its probability minus the previous row's; a creature that is itself a generator is counted with its young), the same at every cell, as the one generator serves all ten; fire damage taken (PropertyFloat 67 'ResistFire') is 1.42 for the drudges (50% of the mass) and 1.0 for the banderling, mites and mosswarts, 0.8 for the Gnawer Shreth, a mean of 1.20 over the band, so fire is no worse than any other element for the rung (cold: 1.42 for the drudges and 0.75-0.8 for the rest). acquire_radius_m 60 is HuntScenario.MeleeRange; cell_cap 8 is HuntScenario.OnFootMaxCells; expected_yield_per_spot is the sum of spawn_mass over the creatures in level_band M6 16 Q12: the facts a creature's from_bestiary names (any of max_health, resist_health_drain) are read from the bestiary's tables (the same pinned world SQL rows) at load; the numbers each ground reads are unchanged (GroundCreatureNumbersTests).

loot.source: M6 7 lead (2026-11-07, live: the tusk dropped and the pack had no slot; 160 refused pick-ups): min_free_slots 3: the pack keeps room for what a quest needs. M6 7 AR (the audit's rows 15, 28, 32; closes TODO(m6-outskirts-loot)): she earned about 2,000 pyreals an hour against about 25,000 of scrolls because only 12 of 457 corpses were opened in the four stretches of gate A (the radius was 15 m and she shoots from 60 m: 445 logged 'beyond the loot radius': 157 at 15 to 20 m, 60 at 20 to 40, 162 at 40 to 60, 66 past it, the live logs cache/m6/7/live/gateA-climb*). Those 12 corpses held 59,774 Value and the sales paid 39,924 pyreals at Holtburg's vendors (buy_price 0.9, ACE GetBuyCost max(1, floor(rate x Value + 0.1)), Vendor.cs:591-598 @95ef426d; one trip 29,587), and 11,837 of Value was left over the load line, the 7,596 breastplate among it (Renald pays 6,836: a level IV scroll and more). radius_m 60: the whole shot: an open costs about 8 s a corpse (30 m on average at 5.5 m/s, plus the open). min_value_per_burden 10: on the 12 corpses it keeps 40,188 of the 59,774 Value for 1,323 of about 4,500 burden: rings, cups, stoups, shoes, essences, the breastplate; it leaves the weapons and the 7.7 cuirass. load_line_percent 125: she stands at 94% of 4,800 with 391 tapers and no room for one armour piece; 125% gives 1,500 burden (ACE's burden mod 0.75 at the line, EncumbranceSystem.GetBurdenMod) and the trip is due there and sells every thing: about 110 burden a corpse under this floor, so about 14 corpses a trip. Expected coin: about 50 kills an hour x 83% in reach x 3,000 pyreals a corpse = about 120,000 an hour at the sample's mean; a 25-minute cycle with its trip, and the tail of the sample (one sale of 29,587) halves it: plan on about 60,000 an hour, 30 times today's. Unmeasured at this rule: read coin on the [ladder] line after the first hour

fight.source: M6 7 AN (the owner, 2026-11-06: outdoors the words are about the dungeon and the next fight: today's outdoor line stays, as data): pull_stamina_percent 30 and pull_rest_until_percent 80 are the vitals keeper's own lines of today (VitalsOptions.DefaultStaminaUnderPercent and DefaultStaminaUntilPercent); pull_mana_percent 20 is today's mana line, the keeper's rest for the next cast, 33 of 163 in the climb of 2026-11-06 13:57 UTC; pull_aggro_metres 24 as the Lodge's; she lies down to recharge. rest_s_per_kill= on the verdict lets the lead measure what a fuller line would cost; no lower line is chosen here
